{{nihongo|'''Yuki Shrine'''|行神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mutsu Province]].

'''Yuki Shrine''' (ゆきじんじゃ) is a shrine listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki Shikinaisha}} located in Shitoda, {{ill|Tomiya, Miyagi|ar|تومييا|ce|Томия|ceb|Tomiya|es|Tomiya (Miyagi)|fa|تومیا، میاگی|fi|Tomiya|fr|Tomiya|id|Tomiya, Miyagi|it|Tomiya|ja|富谷市|ko|도미야시|mg|Tomiya|ms|Tomiya, Miyagi|nl|Tomiya|pl|Tomiya|ru|Томия|sv|Tomiya|tl|Tomiya, Miyagi|tr|Tomiya|tt|Томия|uk|Томія|ur|ٹومیا، میاگی|vi|Tomiya, Miyagi|zh|富谷市|zh_classical|富谷市|zh_yue|富谷|qid=Q1205173}}, {{ill|Miyagi Prefecture|Q47896|qid=Q47896}}.<ref name=jinjacho>{{Cite web|Japanese|url=http://www.town.tomiya.miyagi.jp/html/shuyu/index3.html|title=Tomiya City / Tomiya Shūyū|publisher=Tomiya City|accessdate=2015-03-09}}</ref>

=== Overview ===
The northern part of Tomiya City is characterized by expansive {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=rice paddies}}, and the shrine stands atop a hill about 300 meters from a side road west of {{ill|Japan National Route 4|af|Japan Nasionale Roete 4|de|Nationalstraße 4 (Japan)|es|Ruta Nacional 4 (Japón)|id|Jalan Raya Nasional Jepang Rute 4|ja|国道4号|ko|국도 제4호선 (일본)|ru|Кокудо 4|zh|國道4號 (日本)|zh_min_nan|Ji̍t-pún Kok-tō 4-hō|qid=Q1055023}}, at the eastern edge of the {{ill|Hügelland|cs|Pahorkatina|de|Hügelland|fr|Basse montagne|hak|Khiu-lîn|ja|丘陵|ko|구릉|nl|Heuvelland (landschap)|pl|Wysoczyzna|sk|Pahorkatina|zh|丘陵|zh_classical|丘陵|zh_yue|丘陵|qid=Q222912}} in the Shitoda area to the northwest. It is one of the Shikinaisha shrines, of which there were one hundred in the former {{ill|Mutsu Province|Q907389|qid=Q907389}} and four in {{ill|Kurokawa District, Miyagi|ceb|Kurokawa-gun|fr|District de Kurokawa|id|Distrik Kurokawa, Miyagi|it|Distretto di Kurokawa|ja|黒川郡|ko|구로카와군|pl|Powiat Kurokawa|ru|Курокава (уезд)|uk|Повіт Курокава|zh|黑川郡|zh_yue|黑川郡|qid=Q1131782}}. During the {{ill|Daijosai|Q11433653|qid=Q11433653}}, two temporary halls—the Yuki-den and the Suki-den—are specially constructed to the east and west, where the ritual ceremonies are conducted. There is also a theory that considers the shrine’s significance in connection with Suki Shrine, which is enshrined in {{ill|Ōhira, Miyagi|Q1204681|qid=Q1204681}} to the north of this shrine. Within the precincts stands a cedar tree approximately 20 meters tall with a trunk circumference of over 3 meters, estimated to be more than 700 years old.

* About 10 minutes by car from {{ill|Sendai-Hokubu Road|Q11377788|qid=Q11377788}} {{ill|Tomiya interchange|Q16144881|qid=Q16144881|lt=Tomiya IC}}
* About 20 minutes by car from {{ill|Tōhoku Expressway|Q428428|qid=Q428428}} {{ill|Izumi interchange|Q11143029|qid=Q11143029|lt=Izumi IC}}
